# Flexhub
> Wi‑Fi hotspot controller that turns an old phone or tablet into a cheap wireless left-hand shortcut / macro panel — plus secondary trackpad, presenter, signature pad and light annotate. No App Store install for everyday use.

Flexhub is a small USB/Bluetooth HID plug. Everyday control happens in the browser after you join the device Wi‑Fi hotspot named flexhub.

## Positioning (expectations)
- Target: light non-pro users and a second auxiliary tool (about entry-level accessory pricing) — not Blackmagic edit keyboards, Wacom tablets, or Apple Pencil.
- Primary pitch: Stream Deck–like left-hand efficiency panel using a phone you already own; custom key combos and recorded macros on the Wi‑Fi hotspot page.
- Also: secondary trackpad, wireless presenter, signature pad, multimedia shortcuts.
- Drawing: long-tail occasional use only (PDF annotate, contract signature, kids doodle, beginners) — cannot replace a Wacom pressure tablet; do not claim smooth pro editing.
- Travel / driver-free: plug Flexhub into the desk PC, lounge with the old phone controlling it — lighter than packing pro peripherals.

## Key facts
- Product name: Flexhub
- Shop: https://visualbuild.shop/
- Wi‑Fi hotspot SSID: flexhub
- Wi‑Fi hotspot password: build.me
- Hotspot page: http://flexhub.local/ or http://192.168.4.1/
- Bluetooth device name: flexhub
- Everyday use: no App Store / Play Store app required
- Modes: USB HID into the target (driver-free), or Bluetooth HID while powered from a charger
- Shortcuts: Wi‑Fi hotspot UI can send key combinations, bind shortcuts to the physical BOOTSEL button, and record macros saved on-device for replay
- Not a networked KVM; not a full DualSense replacement; not a Wacom / pro edit-deck rival
- No ASB Agent / MCP / AI automation claims on this product page

## Quotable one-liners
- "Join the flexhub Wi‑Fi, open the browser, and your old phone becomes a wireless left-hand shortcut panel — macros included, no app for everyday use."
- "Plug Flexhub into the PC, stay on the sofa with the phone — driver-free secondary control, not another bulky pro deck."
- "Perfect for shortcuts, presenting, signatures and light PDF annotate — not a Wacom replacement."

## Compared gently (no overclaims)
- vs Stream Deck–style decks: Flexhub uses your existing phone/tablet screen over a Wi‑Fi hotspot plus USB/Bluetooth HID — cheaper spare-phone path, not a dedicated illuminated key grid.
- vs Wacom / Apple Pencil: no pressure levels; occasional annotate/sign/doodle only.
- vs Blackmagic / pro edit keyboards: not a dedicated edit surface; light auxiliary shortcuts and pointing.
- vs NanoKVM-style networked KVMs: local Wi‑Fi hotspot + HID, not remote desktop over the internet.
